physical.scope: One query and three public documents; actual Electron renderer adapter and installed host; no independent application operator
physical.recoveryScope: Fresh-process execution after earlier fault runs, using the final evaluation Pack; not in-session device restoration or resumable downloads

adverse.q4kInterpretation: Candidate rejected against pinned source. Original Q4K source repository/revision missing, so quantization is not established as the sole cause.
adverse.staleKernelBuild: Earlier evaluation build rejected stale SiLU digest. Only the new conversion candidate pin was corrected; historical artifacts were not rewritten.
adverse.scoringControl: Existing F16 recipe used logit_difference and was rejected for scoring-contract mismatch; a distinct true_logit candidate was built and qualified.
adverse.deviceLoss: Generic pre-fix GPU error retained. Fixed runtime rejects lost devices with DOPPLER_GPU_DEVICE_LOST; Electron preserves DOPPLER_ELECTRON_DEVICE_LOST and closes.

exclusions: Original Q4K weights; original Q4K provenance is incomplete

evidence.error: Invalid rerank reference: observed scoring contract differs.
